The module derives the         per-step extra as `totalPpm - basePpm` and calls the hook's         `mevModuleSetSniperFee(poolKey, extraPpm)` accordingly.         The pool's actual LP fee is NEVER changed by this module \u2014 the         locker reward split keeps receiving only the pool's configured         base fee throughout the sniper window.         Default LAYER schedule:           basePpm = 10_000 (1.00%)           step 0:  0\u201360s     500_000 ppm total (extra 490_000)           step 1:  60\u2013180s   250_000 ppm total (extra 240_000)           step 2:  180\u2013300s  150_000 ppm total (extra 140_000)           step 3:  300\u2013600s   70_000 ppm total (extra  60_000)           step 4:  600\u2013900s   30_000 ppm total (extra  20_000)           after 900s: disabled (normal pool fee resumes; no extra)         Validation:           - schedule.length \u2208 [1, 16]           - feePpm strictly monotonically decreasing           - feePpm[0] \u2264 MAX_FEE (990_000)           - basePpm < feePpm[last]  (every step has a positive extra)           - sum(durationSec) \u2264 hook.MAX_MEV_MODULE_DELAY() (15m for LAYER hook)           - sum(durationSec) \u2264 7200 (2h absolute hard cap)           - each durationSec > 0","kind":"dev","methods":{"beforeSwap((address,address,uint24,int24,address),(bool,int256,uint160),bool,bytes)":{"params":{"artCoinIsToken0":"True if the ArtCoins token is token0.","mevModuleSwapData":"Encoded swap-time data specific to the module.","poolKey":"The pool key.","swapParams":"The swap parameters."},"returns":{"disableMevModule":"True if the hook should disable further MEV-module calls."}},"getCurrentExtraFeePpm((address,address,uint24,int24,address))":{"returns":{"_0":"Zero after the schedule completes; otherwise the active step's         total minus the configured base."}},"initialize((address,address,uint24,int24,address),bytes)":{"details":"`mevModuleInitData = abi.encode(Step[] schedule, uint24 basePpm)`.
